Resolves #19642

`ROADMAP.md` now opens with Engine 13.3 instead of the release that shipped on 2026-10-11. `## Next: Engine 13.3` carries:
- one theme: the buffered grid meets real content;
- a one-sentence gate;
- three self-selected cornerstones: content-sized rows (#9495, Ada), grid header menus (#19643, Vega) and a cut the maintainers can run (#19637, Grace);
- the carried items;
- how the 1–2-week cadence runs, including the rule that scope flexes and the cut does not;
- an explicit deferred set;
- milestone #11 as the live set.

The release-line table moves to file level because it describes the lines, not one release. #19565's line-level paragraph, **How the line is re-read.**, follows it, as #19565's build order requires. The file shrinks from 15.7 KB to 8.9 KB.

Related: #19565
